items.title: The category of coherent formal modules is abelian: for X Noetherian and I a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, Coh(X, I) is abelian, restriction to open subsets is exact, and exactness can be checked on the members of an open covering.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The kernel construction and every claim are carried out in the span: cokernels are given termwise (the author marks the verification 'details omitted'); kernels are built from K'_{l,m} = Im(Ker(alpha_l) -> F_m), with the four enumerated claims (a)-(d) proved affine-locally by translating through the equivalence of lemma-inverse-systems-affine to a map f : M -> N of finite A^-modules, choosing c by Artin-Rees (algebra-lemma-Artin-Rees and algebra-lemma-map-AR) so that K'_{l,m} = (K + I^m M)/I^m M for l >= m + c, hence K'_m corresponds to K/(K cap I^m M) and K_n = K/I^n K; the universal property of the kernel is verified directly from the transition-map structure; Coim = Im follows because kernels and cokernels over affines commute with the module-category description and hold there; parts (2) and (3) are then immediate from the constructed kernels and cokernels as the author states.
